# Arm kit (generated by build.py)

What the swap from the catch robot to the arm robot takes off and puts on (design.md 12.3). The base, the head and their boards stay; the camera bar turns to its arm index; the face unit and the audio box move to the kit's seats.

Arm robot: **7.76 kg**, CG at [17.3, 0.1, 123.8] mm (the SO-101 stowed, est).
